note: What a reader should have for their own game at the end of each part. Keyed by part id, which both paths share; shown after the last chapter of the part.

zh-CN: 一个你想改的游戏，和它一个回合的三句话描述
一段观察记录：有人停下、笑出来或皱眉的那一刻
你的第一位试玩者是谁，能待多久
一句方向：你想让玩家多做的那一件事
en: A game you want to change, and three sentences describing one of its turns
One observation: a moment when someone paused, laughed, or frowned
Who your first player is, and how long they can stay
One sentence of direction: the one thing you want players to do more

zh-CN: 三个小改法，其中留下了一个
写成动作的一条规则：从轮到谁一直写到换人
一份只回答一个问题的小草稿
第一次试玩的三栏记录
en: Three small changes, with one kept
One rule written as an action, from whose turn it is to handing over
A small draft that answers one question
A three-column record of your first playtest

zh-CN: 一个写清了结算顺序的边界局面
一次真正有差别、玩家也看得出差别的选择
一样有限的东西：写清它从哪来、用掉后去哪里
一个让等待的人也有事可想的改动
en: One tricky moment with its order of resolution written down
One choice whose options really differ, in a way players can see
One limited thing, with where it comes from and where it goes
One change that gives waiting players something to think about

zh-CN: 一张东西怎样流动的小图
开头、中间、结尾，各一句玩家在意什么
两个点子合起来后冒出的问题，以及你的处理
一个互相帮忙或互相妨碍的动作；换过一次人数或先后顺序
en: A small sketch of what flows through your game
One line each for what players care about at the beginning, middle, and end
The question that appeared when two ideas were combined, and what you did about it
One action for helping or hindering, and one try with a different player count or order

zh-CN: 关键动作的叫法或画法，问过朋友哪一种更好记
一段玩家自己讲出的故事
放在操作发生处的提示
一处为看不清、够不到或读得慢的人改过的材料
en: A name or picture for the key action, checked with a friend
A short story of a game, told by a player
Reminders placed where the actions happen
One piece of material changed for someone who cannot see well, reach far, or read quickly

zh-CN: 第二次试玩的记录，他做的事和你的解释分开写
一句反馈，以及你为它只改的那一条规则
en: A record of a second playtest, with what they did kept apart from what you explained
One piece of feedback, and the single rule you changed for it

zh-CN: 定下来的一版，其余写进“以后再试”
一位没听你讲解的人照规则开局的记录
装在一起的规则、材料和邀请，写着版本号
en: One settled version, with the rest on a “try later” list
A record of someone starting from your written rules without your explanation
Rules, materials, and an invitation packed together and marked with a version
